mapper.sql: id, exercise_id, student_id, assignment_id, answer_content, is_correct, answer_time, time_spent_seconds, created_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as correct, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as incorrect FROM student_exercise_answers WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
